title: Dissociating performance from compositional feature learning
abstract: arXiv:2505.09716v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation is considered a hallmark of human and animal intelligence. To achieve OOD through composition, a system must discover the environment-invariant properties of experienced input-output mappings and transfer them to novel inputs. This can be realised if an intelligent system can identify appropriate, task-invariant, and composable input features, as well as the composition methods, thus allowing it to act based not on the interpolation between learnt data points but on the task-invariant composition of those features. We propose that in order to confirm that an algorithm does indeed learn compositional structures from data, it is not enough to just test on an OOD setup, but one also needs to confirm that the features identified are indeed compositional. We showcase this by exploring two tasks with clearly defined OOD metrics that are not OOD solvable by three commonly used neural networks:

translated_title: 将性能与组合式特征学习相解耦
translated_abstract: 分布外泛化被视为人类和动物智能的标志。要通过组合实现分布外泛化，系统必须发现所经历的输入-输出映射中的环境不变属性，并将其迁移到新输入上。如果一个智能系统能够识别合适的、任务不变且可组合的输入特征，以及相应的组合方法，从而使其行为不是基于已学习数据点之间的插值，而是基于这些特征的任务不变组合，那么这一目标就可以实现。我们提出，为了确认一个算法确实从数据中学到了组合结构，仅仅在分布外设置上进行测试是不够的，还需要确认所识别出的特征确实是组合性的。我们通过探索两个具有明确定义的分布外指标的任务来展示这一点，而这三个常用神经网络无法在这些任务上实现分布外求解：
tldr: 本文提出，仅凭分布外性能测试不足以证明算法学到了组合结构，还必须验证所学特征本身具有组合性，并通过两个常用神经网络无法解决的分布外任务展示了性能与组合特征学习之间的分离。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that OOD testing alone is insufficient to confirm that an algorithm has learned compositional structures—one must also verify that the identified features are genuinely compositional—as demonstrated through two tasks that three common neural networks cannot solve in an OOD manner.
